description: This source file defines the internal system for managing grain activation migrations between silos in Orleans. It includes interfaces and classes for migrating grain activations, handling migration requests, and orchestrating migration workers with queue processing, cluster membership monitoring, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: ActivationMigrationManager
classes.description: Manages migration of grain activations to other silos, handling migration requests and cluster membership updates, with batching and queue processing.

classes.name: MigrationWorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of work for migrating a grain, encapsulating migration data and completion logic, with object pooling for efficiency.

methods.name: AcceptMigratingGrains
methods.description: Handles incoming migration packages, ensuring target activations are created or retrieved, and waits until all activations are active or terminal.

methods.name: MigrateAsync
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous migration of a specific grain to a target silo by enqueueing a migration work item.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Monitors cluster membership changes and removes workers targeting silos that are terminating.

methods.name: PumpMigrationQueue
methods.description: Processes queued migration work items for a target silo, calling remote accept method in batches, and handling errors.

methods.name: GetOrCreateWorker
methods.description: Creates and retrieves a migration worker channel for a target silo, starting a processing task if necessary.

methods.name: RemoveWorker
methods.description: Removes and terminates a worker for a given target silo, signaling any pending work items as failed.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Placeholder for startup logic, currently returning completed task.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down all migration workers, cancelling ongoing tasks and completing work channels.
